title: Cindercrown's Cooling Forge
story: Cindercrown the Ember Smith has chained the village bell inside his volcano forge, and it can only be freed with 91 hammer-strikes on the chain. Mr 6 strikes 7 times per minute, but the forge floor cracks open after 15 minutes, so he needs to know his timing exactly.
question: At 7 strikes per minute, how many minutes does Mr 6 need to land all 91 strikes?
hint: How many sevens fit into 91? Try 7 times 10 first, then see what's left over.
victory: The chain fell at minute thirteen with two minutes to spare, and Cindercrown was so impressed by the arithmetic that he forged Mr 6 a brand-new number-shaped shield.
imagePrompt: A crown-of-embers blacksmith monster looming over a glowing anvil in a volcanic forge with lava seams in the floor, as a numeral-six knight hammers a chained bell free amid orange sparks.
solution: Ask how many 7s fit into 91: 7 × 10 = 70 strikes in the first 10 minutes.
That leaves 91 - 70 = 21 strikes, and 21 ÷ 7 = 3 more minutes.
praise: Splitting the big number into easier chunks was clever thinking — you just needed to add both chunks of time together at the end.
